NLE.note: ICV '¡Ponte las nuevas!' graphic. The left half shows the expired 'Nuevo León Unido' plate stamped VENCIDA; the crop keeps only the right-hand new plate (AAA-000-A, gold lion emblem, NUEVOLEÓN wordmark, 'Transporte privado automóvil'), held slightly tilted, with a hand touching its right edge. After the crop the plate fills the frame, ratio about 1.6. Also serves as the standard plate.

PUE.note: Official photo of the green version on its own, filling the frame: PUEBLA header, AAA-000-A, volcano and folk-art scene, 'Placa conmemorativa 2026', the mascot, and the Mexico 2026 seal. The red version on its own is in the same gallery: Finanzas_2104_(4).jpeg (2560x1437).

SPFA poster (Oct 2025) with a clean plate artwork inset at lower right. The crop isolates the plate: 000-AAA, a green leaf with 'Vehículo ecológico', the 'Pensar en Grande' band and 'Transporte privado'. Ratio about 1.9. This is the 2024-2030 Armenta-era design, not the 2022 'Hacer historia' design.
